issues.description: In Aufgabe 02 the solution uses the column Freizeitpark.id to join to Gemeinde.schluessel, but the rest of the exercises and schema use a foreign-key column named gemeindeschluessel on place-related tables (e.g. Zoo.gemeindeschluessel, Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel). Concretely, solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql line 3 contains: WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.id — this mismatched identifier is likely a typo and will confuse students about the correct join column name and how to write the join correctly.
issues.suggestedFix: In solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql change the WHERE clause to use the consistent foreign-key name: replace WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.id with WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel. Verify that the Freizeitpark table in the schema uses the column name gemeindeschluessel; if the schema actually uses a different name, align the solution and the problem statement to the canonical schema name so students see a consistent foreign-key identifier across exercises.
